A day in Yosemite Valley

Big scenery, short viewpoints, plenty of car time and a picnic break.

Open day route ↗
✳
Good to know

Morning go/no-go: check Highway 41, Wawona Road, and Yosemite chain controls before leaving. R0 means chains are not currently required for installation; restrictions or icy spots can develop later. Bring fitted chains if available and do not enter a controlled road without required equipment.

Day highlights

Before you go

Roads & comfort

🏔️ Friday: check Yosemite roads at 6 AM

Call 209-372-0200 (press 1, then 1). R0 does not guarantee the roads will stay clear all day. Take fitted tire chains if you have them and follow posted controls.

🌅 Saturday: sunset around 4:43 PM

Leave Woodward by 2:35 PM. Skip an optional stop if needed to get to Millerton before dark.

💛 Mobility-first

Accessible parking and restrooms when available, layers for cold mornings, and no mandatory hikes. Check holiday business hours.
